subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should approved sandboxed Workspaces widgets receive a supported durable `state:persist` capability through the trusted browser parent and plugin-owned SQLite database?
rationale: This creates a lasting widget API and expands the trusted parent's authority over data supplied by hostile iframe code; automated tests cannot decide whether that product and security boundary should become supported.

options.title: Approve the bounded capability
options.body: Accept the 64 KiB JSON, host-bound identity, optimistic concurrency, and transactional cleanup contract after real browser proof and correction of the closing reference.

options.title: Restrict persistence to trusted widgets
options.body: Keep durable widget state behind first-party Workspaces APIs and remove the custom iframe bridge capability.

options.title: Defer widget persistence
options.body: Pause this PR and its dependent widget work until the broader Workspaces API direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded capability
recommendation.body: Accept the 64 KiB JSON, host-bound identity, optimistic concurrency, and transactional cleanup contract after real browser proof and correction of the closing reference.
